content.text: With our Splendid Meghalaya Day Trip from Guwahati, travellers can experience the best of Meghalaya all in one day. This tour offers a visit to the serene lakes like Umiam Lake, lush green landscapes like Shillong Golf Course and Lady Hydari Park, waterfalls like Elephant Falls and the unique Mawphlang Sacred Forest. It is indeed a refreshing escape from the busy city life and is a memorable getaway into the peaceful and calm nature.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Witness the Umiam Lake, a scenic stopover on your way
Engage in a nature walk at the well-maintained Lady Hydari Park
Discover the unique Mawphlang Sacred Forest

main.title: Splendid Meghalaya Day Trip from Guwahati Itinerary

items: You will be received by our representative from Guwahati Airport/Railway Station.
Your Meghalaya Day Tour will begin with a drive to Shillong also known as the 'Scotland of the East'.
On the way to Shillong, travellers can enjoy a stopover at the Umiam Lake. Spending time at this beautiful viewpoint can provide relaxation to the visitors and they can even engage in photography.

Next, witness the spanning lush green Lady Hydari Park. This is another refreshing retreat for the travellers as they can engage in nature walks adoring the unique species of colourful orchids. A mini zoo is another attraction in the park.

Elephant Falls will be the next destination of your day's tour. Witness the charm of this mesmerising three-tiered falls all surrounded in lush greenery. Spend a quality time here, indulge in photography and relax at this destination.

Lastly, drive to the Mawphlang Sacred Forest. Explore this unique forest which is believed to be over 800 years old and holds strong beliefs of the Khasi community. It is an abode to numerous rare medicinal plants, orchids, moss-covered trees, mushrooms and unique flora. Spend a good time witnessing rich biodiversity here, learning about the history of this forest and get a chance to interact with the locals as well.
After the wonderful excursion, you will be dropped back to Guwahati Airport/Railway Station which will end your splendid Meghalaya day trip.
